subject: Contained WVB 1.37 native pointer lowering and focused current-source verification
claim: Implementation commit 4537c4ca132d1ad9b381238d750b6152230b015d lowers the compiler-confined WVB 1.37 write-pointer descriptor to native x86-64 without forming a host address, and its Windows development owner builds the current 648-function lowerer and completes 13 focused cases in 36.85 seconds instead of selecting 21 unrelated owners.

runs.target: Current-source native x86-64 lowerer development owner
Changed-file owner selection and registry policy
Documentation catalogs, retrieval, links, anchors, and active contracts

limitations: The pointer contains only a private packed logical start/length descriptor; no host address or Foreign-call authority is formed.
The focused owner ran on Windows only; Linux execution and paired-host qualification remain pending.
The development package cache is not release evidence and fresh deterministic reconstruction remains required at qualification.

The owner covers current-source compilation, two inherited exact WVO identities, one WVB 1.37 native execution, and ten malformed cases; additional lowerer-owned behavior still requires its own representative cases as that behavior changes.
Authenticated no-retain Foreign lowering, one real migrated system boundary, required Libraries 1.0 profiles, and final qualification remain pending.
